intent: Spinning circular loader for short indeterminate waits. One piece. Sizes 12, 16, 20. inverse for a primary fill. Distinct from LoadingAnimation dot-grid.
useWhen: An inline action is processing (for a kit Button, set loading instead)
Short indeterminate page or panel load
Waiting state with no known percent
doNotUseWhen: Square dot-grid compact wait — use LoadingAnimation
An indeterminate bar that sits with the work — use Meter value=indeterminate
Placeholder layout while data arrives — use Skeleton

label.note: Visible label beside the spinner. When omitted, aria-label is Loading.

inverse.note: On a primary fill: the mark and label use the on-primary ink. A kit Button with loading already draws its own spinner in the button ink.

requirements: aria-label Loading when label is omitted
Visible label is not duplicated in aria-label
Reduced motion: the mark stays still and the label stays

doNot: Do not invent SpinnerIcon or merge Spinner into LoadingAnimation
Do not add Spinner as a LoadingAnimation variant
Do not change Button to accept spinner children
Do not color a spinner by hand on a primary fill — set inverse
